purpose: From-scratch neural ADMET baseline using only the supplied official structures and labels
official_valence_exception: Preserve the original input graph, atoms, bonds, charges and hydrogens; if full RDKit sanitization fails, skip only the valence/property check and require all remaining sanitization stages to pass. Record every exception.
model: Two randomly initialized masked multitask neural models: residual shared trunk and task-gated shared/private mixture of experts
selection: Per-task shared/gated mixture selected on three global identity-and-scaffold folds of official train. Mean CV MAE or rank metric with leave-fold selection stability. A fresh global scaffold holdout from train+valid confirms selected gated contribution; failing tasks use shared baseline. Official valid metrics are diagnostic only. Selection and fresh check freeze before fitting all official train+valid for test inference.
classification_loss: BCE with true label prevalence; 0.1 pairwise ranking on the uniformly sampled task
regression_loss: MAE on fit-only median/IQR targets; Spearman tasks Gaussian-rank targets plus pairwise ranking
label_matrix: Only fitting rows; all task labels of held scaffold groups and canonical molecular identities excluded globally
train_device: cuda; training must refuse CPU and Windows
limitations: All official development labels have previously been used; new partitions are not new independent data.
This provides a clean independent baseline rather than reproducing the historical full ensemble.
Official score gain requires platform measurement.
